sentences.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 板栗至少需要煮十五分钟。

sentences.en: You should brush your teeth at least twice a day.
sentences.zh: 你应该每天至少刷牙两次。

sentences.en: Every reporter sent his stories with the least possible delay.
sentences.zh: 每个记者都尽可能快地提交了他们的报道。
